semantics.backend: Coordinator accumulated admission backend_ms, including attempted backend work
semantics.capacity_wait: sum of Coordinator WAITING_CAPACITY intervals, including retries; excludes backend work
semantics.cross_clock: Ready→setup, node→requested and failure-window labels combine driver and Coordinator wall times; synchronization error is unmeasured; signed differences are retained
semantics.legacy_gateway: legacy gateway_queue_seconds is a separate field from native Coordinator capacity wait
semantics.requested_to_ready: Coordinator admission wait_age_ms at READY, includes capacity wait, backend and control overhead

assignment.scope: assignment.resources.memoryBytes; repeated samples are observations, unique actors use actorUid; memory-only slots omit CPU/runtime/placement constraints

analysis_window.endpoint: latest recorded calibration workload_completed_at or released_at; excludes later cleanup

failure.scope: failed sessions with a PG READY allocation still open at their failure, clipped at the next PG resource release or analysis endpoint; cross-clock estimate; identifies observed exposure, not a counterfactual performance correction

forecast.scope: saved DES queue begins at arrival/observed return and ends at simulated admission; includes snapshot readiness, excludes initial/restore service; simulation time; no replay or fitting performed

tools.clock: Coordinator tool receipt started_at/finished_at wall-clock timestamps
tools.excess_scope: completed active tool duration minus its matching source node sleep; receipt overhead includes shell/RAM work; sums across concurrent sessions are actor-time, not makespan
